result:
The blog now supports Japanese, with a language switcher in the site header. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (9 passing, 7 of them new) and the full `bunx guren gate` (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, test) all pass. I didn't boot the app or click the switcher in a browser. The tests drive the app in-process.

- **Detecting the language:** the framework already reads a `locale` cookie before `Accept-Language`, so the reader's pick beats the browser's setting. English stays the default.
- **`POST /locale`:** it takes `en` or `ja`, sets that cookie for one year, and sends the reader back to the page in the `Referer`. It uses the same validation as the post title, so `fr` or a missing field gets the same 422 and the cookie is left alone.
- **Referer on another site:** the redirect goes to `/` instead of following it, so the endpoint can't be used to bounce readers off-site. When the Referer is on the same site, the redirect uses it exactly as sent, e.g. `http://localhost/posts`, not `/posts`.
- **Catalogs:** the Japanese files under `lang/ja/` have exactly the same 31 keys as the English ones, including the welcome message, and the catalog check passes. All nine keys in the contract have the required Japanese values. No page or component contains 「記事」 itself.

A few English labels changed wording to match the new keys: the header now has a "Home" link, and "Write" (`posts.new`) is 新規投稿 in Japanese.

**What changed:** I added `ja` to the supported languages in `src/app.ts`, taking the list from the new `app/Http/Validators/LocaleValidator.ts` so the switcher and the language detection use the same list. The new `app/Http/Controllers/LocaleController.ts` handles `POST /locale` (route `locale.update` in `routes/web.ts`). The new catalogs are `nav`, `auth`, `posts` and `locale` in `lang/en/` and `lang/ja/`, plus `lang/ja/messages.json`. The header in `resources/js/components/Layout.tsx` now reads its labels from the catalogs and has an English/日本語 dropdown. The posts list, post page and new/edit forms (`resources/js/pages/posts/`) read all their text from the catalogs too. The new tests in `tests/LocaleController.test.ts` cover the redirects, the cookie, rejected values, and how `_i18n.locale` follows the browser or the reader's pick.
